payload.summary: Crisis numbers: re-verify all seven against their official sources every six months (next due by March 2027)
payload.detail: src/lib/crisis-contacts.ts is the single source for every real crisis number shown (safety plan, care plan, offline page). Four WA numbers verified 2026-08-20 and re-confirmed unchanged 2026-09-26 against EMHS MHERL (page updated 18/08/2026) and Rurallink pages; three national lines verified 2026-09-25. Nothing reminds anyone to re-check. When re-checking: compare number and hours to each sourceUrl, move verifiedOn only for entries actually re-checked, run npm run offline:build (bumps the offline page, so new CACHE_VERSION + hash pin in tests/pwa-manifest.test.ts), and update docs/care-plan/crisis-lines-verification.md.
